description: Qualified support, negated opposition and an ambiguous 'that bill' after two bill references.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'm Casey Brooks with Example Small Business Forum.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I support parts of H.4004, but its reporting requirements need changes.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I do not oppose S.5005, but I am not endorsing it.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: H.4004 and S.5005 both concern notices.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: That bill would require an annual report.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: What would that bill require from smaller shops?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: An annual report, although I would need to check which version.
